This is classic fraud (诈骗) – obtaining money by false pretenses. Possibly also "非法经营" but main is fraud. In examples, similar case: "合同诈骗" used when fraud in contract context. The examples: For loan fraud they used "贷款诈骗". For selling fake goods they used "假冒注册商标". For false sale of product they used "诈骗". So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>. Possibly also "非法经营" not needed. So final answer.
